subject: S15b review fixes landed (5/5); see body
body:
S15b re-done after review15b (ledger 20261117T062603-review15b-aee9a0). Commits on claude/naadi-shared: ... c99420b, 0feecaf (review fixes), c37df98 (e2e stability). CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions (branch claude/naadi-shared); I have not seen the result of the matrix for these commits.

(1) MAJOR client undo of pause/cap: migration is **0030** (0029 was taken by pathway, so mine is 0030 down 0029; single head). Client DELETE grant revoked and the delete policy now denies; select policy hides hidden rows. DELETE /api/generated/{id} is a soft hide (hidden_at; file and prompt removed, row stays and keeps counting). The global pause is a server-only table generation_state (RLS forced, no client grants); health reads it. New reached_space column: every run handed to the Space counts toward the cap, failed ones included (timeout); runs the Space never took (unavailable) and quota-refused runs do not. DB tests for both bypasses (client delete refused for rows and state table; delete via API keeps cap; pause survives deleting the owner's rows); rls/live_check/schema.sql updated (58 tables).
(2) MAJOR names: person and patient names are refused (named/called/patient + Capitalised name, my patient X, portrait of X when the name is not followed by an anatomy word, MRN/DOB -> prompt_patient_info with ui_copy key). The three reviewer examples plus the MRN [id] variant are in tests/generation/test_rules.py. The existing scrub_generic still runs; the app has no general name list to reuse beyond the student's own profile (PrivacyContext), so these are rules; heuristics remain.
(3) WebKit e2e: the Trusted Types line came from the service worker registration string; S22's default policy (e403e32) now fixes that at the source, and the spec runs with the worker allowed in that test and no filter. The paused test uses serviceWorkers:"block". A WebKit flake (in-flight /api/onboarding cancelled by navigating off Today) is fixed by opening test users on /settings/account. Smoke set (webkit iPad portrait/landscape, phone 390, chromium 1440, --retries=0): 16/16 on three consecutive runs after the last change (two earlier runs each had one WebKit flake that this fixed).
(4) Space: thin non-GPU wrappers validate (and refuse video_disabled) before any @spaces.GPU function; stub-tested on CPU (tests/gen_space/test_app_wrappers.py).
(5) client.submit() is inside a try: failure -> generation_unavailable, row marked failed and not counted; reconnects next call.

Still open (unchanged): tool/canvas registration waits on S14's registry. Owner steps unchanged from my previous done (Space creation, deploy-gen, HF_GEN_TOKEN, check_env; video stays off until licence confirmed).
